mutations.rationale: Accepts a fifth entry past the bound.
Replaces shifted entries with the last entry, breaking stable order.
Returns the wrong refusal selector for zero.

mutations.before:
if (present[value]) revert AlreadyPresent(value);
        if (entries.length >= CAPACITY) revert Full(CAPACITY);
mutations.after:
if (entries.length >= CAPACITY) revert Full(CAPACITY);
        if (present[value]) revert AlreadyPresent(value);
mutations.rationale: Reports Full instead of AlreadyPresent for duplicate insertion when full.
Truncates observable entries to 128 bits while membership uses 256 bits.
